subtitle: Consumption · Unemployment · Real Business Cycles

blocks.narration: Welcome to the complete exam preparation guide for Intermediate Macroeconomics. Over the next forty minutes we build your full exam toolkit. First, the theory essentials: the Fisher two-period model with different saving and borrowing rates, life-cycle saving, efficiency wages and the Solow condition, Shapiro-Stiglitz shirking, and real business cycles. Then we solve every problem from Tutorial 2 on consumption, Tutorial 4 on unemployment, and Tutorial 5 on real business cycle theory - every Lagrangian, every derivative, every number, step by step. We finish with a one-page crib sheet of all key results. By the end you will be able to reproduce every solution on your own. Let's begin.

outro_message: You are ready for the exam. Good luck!
narration_style: conversational, clear, 3Blue1Brown-like: questions first, then answers
